newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 14.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN Ivorian cabinet statement: _ Government agrees draft 1997 budget for submission to parliament with spending totalling 1,786.1 billion CFA francs, up 1.1 percent on 1996. - Ivory Coast's 1996/97 coffee marketing season opens today; farm-gate minimum guide price for bagged green coffee slashed from 700 CFA francs to 500 CFA per kilo because of fall in world price. - Ivorian government to negotiate with French group ACCOR over concession to run former Novotel Hotel in commercial capital Abidjan. - Government to negotiate with French group Colas and Jean-Lefebvre for improvement, part-construction and management of motorway between Abidjan and the capital Yamoussoukro and construction and management of an express-way between Abidjan and seaside town of Grand Bassam LA VOIE - Three more opposition activists, jailed during opposition boycott and violence surrounding October 1995 election of president Henri Konan Bedie, freed from prison on parole; other opposition activists still held - LE JOUR - Ivorian fishermen angrily accuse mostly foreign ship owners of employing non-Ivorians at Abidjan's fishing port. - Air Afrique's managing director designate, Sir Harry Tirvengadum of Mauritius, says he wants to work with the struggling multinational carrier's owners and staff to solve its problems - Brazilian, Moroccan and Spanish companies exhibit at Expo-CI 96 trade fair and some hope to set up branches in Ivory Coast
